En esta posición tendrás la oportunidad de desarrollar habilidades en análisis de datos, creación de contenidos, planeación de materiales promocionales y apoyo en presupuesto de la marca.

¿Qué harás?


Monitoreo y análisis del desempeño de la marca, incluyendo seguimiento de indicadores clave y revisión de información de mercado.

Soporte en el desarrollo y actualización de materiales promocionales, en alineación con la estrategia y lineamientos de la marca.
Apoyo en la implementación y seguimiento de parrillas digitales, asegurando consistencia del mensaje y cumplimiento de calendarios.

Estudiante activo a partir del 6° semestre en Mercadotecnia, Administración, Finanzas, Negocios internacionales, Ingeniería industrial o afín.
Conocimientos en Power Point, Excel. 
Idiomas : inglés intermedio.
Responsabilidad, proactividad, trabajo en equipo, organización y comunicación efectiva.

About the job

MincaAI — Remote Latam, Mexico preferred




About MincaAI

MincaAI is an AI-native insurance software company. HQ at Station F (Paris) x Mexico, operations across LatAm. We build production AI systems for enterprise insurance carriers across three pillars — underwriting, policy issuance, and claims. Real LLM pipelines. Real enterprise clients.

We are small, we move fast, and we ship into environments where being wrong is expensive.




The Role

You own product end-to-end for one of our three pillars. Discovery, spec, delivery, adoption. From messy client reality to shipped feature that carriers actually use in production.

This is a tech PM role, not a stakeholder-management role. You read code, you understand distributed pipelines, you argue architecture with engineers on the merits. You know the difference between "the LLM is wrong," "the prompt is wrong," and "the extraction schema is wrong" — and you know why each one changes the roadmap differently.

Insurance is not a UX layer. Underwriting logic, policy issuance flows, billing reconciliation — the domain complexity is real, and the product decisions live inside it. You will not be handed a domain expert to translate for you. You are expected to learn the business faster than anyone expects, sit with brokers and underwriters, and come back with specs that are right the first time.

Enterprise client reality. We operate a SILO model — each carrier engagement has different infra, different processes, different constraints. Some clients move fast, others arrive with a 200-page compliance checklist. You pivot between these modes without losing velocity. There is no template we deploy blindly.




The Bar

We are hiring for one profile: someone who gets to the bottom of a new problem faster than the room expects, and then does the work.

Speed of comprehension. Dropped into an unfamiliar underwriting workflow, you have the mental model in days, not months. You ask the two questions that matter, not the twenty that don't.
Extreme ownership. No handoffs, no "waiting on engineering," no "the client didn't specify." If it's your pillar and it's broken, it's yours.
High output. This is a demanding role at a startup pace. Roadmaps move weekly, clients escalate, and things ship. If you need a stable backlog and a two-week spec cycle, this isn't it.
Intellectual honesty. You kill your own features when the data says so. You say "I was wrong" fast and cheap.

If you're the person your last team routed the hardest, least-defined problem to — we want to talk.




What You'll Own
Product roadmap for your pillar: quarterly priorities, sequencing, trade-offs. You defend it and you revise it.
Discovery: client interviews, shadowing ops teams, mapping the actual workflow — not the one on the org chart.
Specs and PRDs: precise, testable, engineer-ready. Edge cases, data contracts, and a real definition of "done" for LLM-backed features.
LLM product decisions: which tasks are LLM-shaped, which are deterministic, where to spend inference budget, when to invest in evals vs. ship.
Delivery: sprint planning with tech leads, unblocking, protecting scope, flagging risk before it's a fire.
Client-facing product work: demos, discovery calls, escalations, requirement negotiation. In Spanish and English.
Metrics & adoption: define success per feature, instrument it, and drive follow-through when adoption lags.
Cross-pillar coordination: underwriting, issuance, and billing share data models and services. You align on shared surfaces.




Must-Have
7+ years in product management, at least 3 in B2B / enterprise / SaaS.
Technical depth: you read Python, understand REST/async APIs, and can reason about Postgres schemas and queue-based pipelines. You don't ship code, but no engineer has to translate for you.
Shipped LLM-backed product in production — not a prototype, not a demo. You understand prompts, evals, latency/cost trade-offs, and how LLMs fail quietly.
Track record of learning a hard domain fast and shipping into it. Be ready to prove it with a specific example.
Enterprise discovery & delivery: you've turned non-technical business users' reality into shipped software.
Specs engineers actually praise. Precise, complete, unambiguous.
Bilingual English + Spanish, professional level. Client calls in Spanish, product reviews in English.
Uses AI tools daily (Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT, or equivalent) for discovery synthesis, spec drafting, research, prototyping. Not curiosity — workflow.
Startup-fit: no PM ops layer to hide behind. You draft, you decide, you move.




Nice-to-Have
Insurance domain knowledge: underwriting, policy admin, claims, billing, broker/carrier relationships. Any of it. Strong bonus if you've shipped into a carrier.
Consulting background (MBB, Big 4, boutique strategy) — structured problem-solving, client posture, and comfort in messy enterprise environments is a real plus.
Experience with document-heavy workflows: OCR, extraction, structured output from unstructured input.
Founder, founding PM, or early PM (first three) at a startup.




Our Stack (for context)
Apps: Python / FastAPI microservices, Vite + React + TypeScript
Data: PostgreSQL + pgvector, Redis, S3
AI: OpenAI + Anthropic APIs, in-house evals, RAG pipelines
Infra: Kubernetes (self-managed + OpenShift), AWS, GitHub Actions

If a client request conflicts with the product vision, you push back and propose better.

Describe the hardest domain you had to learn from zero — how long it took you to be dangerous in it, and what you shipped because of it.

Example: You lead team-level conversations and support initiatives that keep Thrive on the leading edge of performance marketing. You get buy-in, work through change management, and successfully collaborate with cross-functional support as needed.

We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:


In your first 30 days you’ll familiarize yourself with Thrive’s tools and processes and begin onboarding to projects and teams across your department, identifying performance opportunities and building relationships.
In your first 60 days you’ll be playing an active role across projects, collaborating with teams on day-to-day and longer term account initiatives. You’ll begin developing processes and strategies to improve team and project success and sharing key insights with others.
In your first 90 days you’ll be stepping into account leadership opportunities, providing support across project planning, strategy, client partnerships and team skills development. 


Qualifications


You have executed, planned and maintained multi-channel, full funnel performance marketing accounts of $200k+ USD media spend per month at a consistently positive ROI for the client across multiple platforms at a time (e.g., Meta, Google Ads, YouTube, Display, Programmatic Platforms, TikTok, Twitter, Spotify and others).
You have experience directly collaborating with and delegating to junior team members as a senior account manager. You have contributed to the development of multiple team members by leading training and providing strategic guidance and project leadership to the point of developing others to the next stage of seniority / role level.
You have advanced analytical skills and are experienced in using visualization tools like Google Sheets, Excel, Google Data Studio, Tableau or similar platforms to pull, sort, analyze and draw insight from ad platforms, analytics, and / or business intelligence tools.
You’ve managed performance media across a range of business verticals and sizes (ecommerce, demand gen, etc), and have been responsible for pacing, forecasting and reporting the impact of performance media on overarching business goals.
You have successfully managed client and / or key stakeholder relationships (ranging in seniority) via weekly touchpoint meetings, quarterly business presentations and asynchronous communication channels (Slack, email, Asana, etc). You’ve resolved difficult stakeholder situations, keeping priorities organized and objectives aligned and have consistently received buy-in on strategic proposals or deliverables.
You have effectively communicated with clients on marketing concepts such as incrementality, KPI selection, attribution and business economics and have incorporated marketing measurement considerations into your strategic approaches.


Equal Opportunity Employer

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works.

About the job

At SiteMinder we believe the individual contributions of our employees are what drive our success. That’s why we hire and encourage diverse teams that include and respect a variety of voices, identities, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. Our diverse and inclusive culture enables our employees to bring their unique selves to work and be proud of doing so. It’s in our differences that we will keep revolutionising the way for our customers. We are better together!

What We Do…

We’re people who love technology but know that hoteliers just want things to be simple. So since 2006 we’ve been constantly innovating our world-leading hotel commerce platform to help accommodation owners find and book more guests online - quickly and simply.

We’ve helped everyone from boutique hotels to big chains, enabling travellers to book igloos, cabins, castles, holiday parks, campsites, pubs, resorts, Airbnbs, and everything in between.

And today, we’re the world’s leading open hotel commerce platform, supporting 50,000 hotels in 150+ countries - with over 130 million reservations processed by SiteMinder’s technology every year.

About The Sales Executive (US Market) Role...

The Business Development Executive will be focused on closing new business. You will plan and prioritize business development activities to achieve company revenue goals and sales targets for defined regions. You will develop and implement innovative commercial strategies to maximize results and support business growth. Ideally, you will leverage existing industry contacts to increase SiteMinder’s client base and brand coverage in the assigned territory.

Client acquisition - Create new opportunities and upsell current customers. You will be responsible for the full sales cycle, from outreach to demo and closing.

CRM maintenance – Maintain accurate records of your business development activities on SiteMinder's CRM system.
Client feedback – Provide client feedback on products to the Product Team so that products can be reviewed in line with the feedback.
Partner management – Work with local industry groups and travel associations to promote SiteMinder’s products and brand. Attend key functions and events, requiring occasional travel to client locations to attend meetings with relevant managers.


What You Have...


Experience in new business acquisition, preferably in the SaaS (software-as-a-service) space, managing the full sales cycle

Esto es posible a través de los productos innovadores de Natura y Avon; las experiencias memorables de los servicios de belleza de Bluma y nuestra plataforma de educación financiera, Emana Pay. Marcas y servicios relevantes para quienes los utilizan y reconocidos por nuestro compromiso con la conducción de negocios regenerativos.

Ocupación

Permanente

Tu misión principal será centralizar la información planificada de cada ciclo, controlar el presupuesto operativo del área y supervisar la cadena punta a punta: desde el trabajo con agencias de diseño e imprentas, hasta asegurar el ingreso físico y oportuno del material impreso al Centro de Distribución.

No es una posición netamente creativa o de escritorio aislada de la operación.
No es un área desconectada de las metas del negocio.
Lo que sí asumirás es el gran reto de ser un/a articulador/a estratégico/a en terreno y oficina, conectando con agencias, área comercial, finanzas y el Centro de Distribución para garantizar que nuestras consultoras reciban sus herramientas en tiempo y forma en todo el país.


¿Qué buscamos en tu perfil?

Experiencia: Experiencia en empresas de Venta Directa (indispensable o altamente deseable) o del sector Cuidado Personal y Belleza. Experiencia comprobable gestionando agencias creativas, imprentas, control de presupuestos y procesos de compras.

Gestión Administrativa en ERP: Generar Órdenes de Compra en SAP, asegurando la recepción de facturas y la gestión oportuna de pagos a proveedores.


¿Qué encontrarás aquí?

Somos más que un lugar de trabajo: construimos y vivimos diariamente el Ecosistema Bien Estar Bien, basado en la relación armoniosa entre cada individuo, las relaciones a su alrededor y el entorno en el que está inmerso. Además de ofrecer beneficios enfocados en el bienestar social, físico, financiero, mental y emocional, promovemos un ambiente de prosperidad, pertenencia y propósito, fortaleciendo una red sólida de apoyo, expansión de la conciencia y respeto por la diversidad, equidad e inclusión.

Somos un movimiento que transforma la forma de vivir y hacer negocios en 14 países de América Latina, siempre guiados por la conciencia.

description:
About the job

Job Summary

EL EQUIPO

El equipo de Marketing Digital es el motor creativo y estratégico que posiciona los eventos en las plataformas más relevantes. Diseñamos campañas digitales que generan awareness, tráfico y conversión, trabajando de la mano con promotores y plataformas globales.

Como Trafficker Digital, serás responsable de implementar y dar seguimiento a campañas en plataformas como Meta, Google, Spotify y TikTok, asegurando que cada acción esté alineada con la estrategia y el presupuesto aprobado. Tu rol será clave para maximizar el impacto de nuestras campañas y garantizar resultados medibles.

Estamos en un momento emocionante: la industria del entretenimiento en vivo está creciendo y Ticketmaster lidera esta transformación con estrategias digitales innovadoras. Este puesto te permitirá trabajar con grandes marcas, plataformas globales y eventos que marcan tendencia.

LO QUE HARÁS


Implementar campañas digitales en plataformas como Meta, Google, Spotify, TikTok y plataformas de Programatic.
Monitorear y controlar la correcta ejecución de campañas según presupuesto y estrategia.

Analizar métricas en tiempo real para realizar ajustes y optimizar resultados.

Interactuar con ejecutivos de plataformas digitales para resolver dudas y explorar mejoras.

Mínimo 2 años de experiencia en implementación de campañas.

Inglés B2-C1, indispensable.

Te apasiona el marketing digital y las tendencias en redes sociales.
Actúas con enfoque en resultados y atención al detalle.
Colaboras activamente con otros equipos y clientes.
Tienes capacidad de análisis y toma de decisiones.
Te adaptas a entornos dinámicos y trabajas bajo presión.


VIDA EN TICKETMASTER

Nos enorgullece formar parte de Live Nation Entertainment, la empresa de

entretenimiento en vivo más grande del mundo. Nuestra visión en Ticketmaster es

conectar a las personas alrededor del mundo con los eventos en vivo que aman.

Como el mercado de boletos más grande del mundo y el proveedor global líder de

herramientas y servicios para la industria del entretenimiento en vivo, estamos en una

posición única para cumplir con esa visión.

Lo hacemos todo con una pasión intensa por el entretenimiento en vivo y una cultura inspiradora y diversa, impulsada por líderes accesibles, gerentes atentos y equipos entusiastas. Si te apasiona el entretenimiento en vivo como a nosotros, y deseas trabajar en una empresa dedicada a ayudar a millones de fanáticos a vivir esa experiencia, queremos saber de ti.

Nuestra Labor Se Guía Por Nuestros Valores

Sentido de pertenencia: Estamos comprometidos a construir una cultura en la que todas las personas puedan ser su yo auténtico, tengan voz igualitaria y oportunidades para prosperar.


OPORTUNIDADES IGUALES

Estamos apasionados y comprometidos con nuestra gente, y vamos más allá de la retórica sobre diversidad e inclusión. Trabajarás en un entorno inclusivo y se te alentará a ser tú mismo en el trabajo. Haremos todo lo posible para ayudarte a equilibrar exitosamente tu vida laboral y personal. Como negocio en crecimiento, fomentaremos que desarrolles tanto tus aspiraciones profesionales como personales, disfrutes de nuevas experiencias y aprendas de las personas talentosas con las que trabajarás. Nos importa el talento, y alentamos las postulaciones de personas sin importar su género, raza, orientación sexual, religión, edad, estado de discapacidad o responsabilidades familiares.

About Four Seasons

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

An urban oasis in the heart of the city. Set around a verdant inner courtyard, our hacienda-style Hotel puts the hectic urban hustle of Mexico’s vibrant capital city seemingly on pause, but only for as long as you’d like. Step outside our doors, and you’ll find yourself on the grand boulevard of Paseo de la Reforma, just a short stroll away from Bosque de Chapultepec and the trendy neighbourhoods of Condesa and Polanco. Want to know what makes Mexico City tick? Join us at Fifty Mils, one of the 50 Best Bars of the world, and taste the cocktails that are captivating Mexico City.

Únete a nuestro equipo diverso y talentoso de Four Seasons Hotel Ciudad de México,

Acerca de Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts: 

Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts abrió su primer hotel en 1961 y su historia es una historia de innovación continua, expansión notable y una dedicación decidida a los más altos estándares. Durante casi 50 años, Four Seasons ha transformado la industria de la hospitalidad al combinar amabilidad y eficiencia con las mejores tradiciones hoteleras internacionales. Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts ha sido clasificado CADA AÑO desde 1998 entre las "100 mejores empresas para trabajar" de la revista FORTUNE y ha sido nombrado "Leyenda del gran lugar para trabajar", un honor que actualmente solo tienen 12 empresas en el mundo.

Operando hoteles, resorts, y propiedades residenciales en los principales centros urbanos y destinos turísticos en más de 47 países, y con diferentes proyectos en planificación o desarrollo, Four Seasons se ubica constantemente entre los mejores hoteles del mundo y las marcas más prestigiosas en las encuestas de lectores, críticas de viajeros y premios de la industria. Nuestro mayor activo, y la clave de nuestro éxito, es nuestra gente.

About the job

Hi! 👋 I’m Alexis, Manager of Client Onboarding. I was born and raised in Argentina 🇦🇷 and joined WeTravel in March 2023 as an Account Manager. In October 2024, I had the exciting opportunity to start and lead our newly created Onboarding department!

Our team’s mission is to help new customers get up and running with WeTravel quickly and effectively. We empower our client’s businesses to grow while taking the load off our Sales team. We love helping people succeed and making the transition to WeTravel smooth, impactful, and efficient!

We’re looking for a motivated, curious, and independent individual to join our team and help shape the future of travel tech. If you thrive in cross-functional environments, enjoy working with teams and clients across the globe, and are excited to make a real difference…this could be the perfect role for you!

How We Work

Our Onboarding team supports new customers right when they need it most. We help our clients get started by migrating important content like reservation details, photos, pricing information, tour descriptions, and more. We also provide personalized trainings to make sure every new customer feels completely confident using the WeTravel platform.

In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with Sales, Account Management, Product, and our customers. Our team is involved across the entire journey, jumping in wherever we can to provide support and make things easier. Are fluent in English (bonus points for other languages!)

At SiteMinder we believe the individual contributions of our employees are what drive our success. That’s why we hire and encourage diverse teams that include and respect a variety of voices, identities, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. Our diverse and inclusive culture enables our employees to bring their unique selves to work and be proud of doing so. It’s in our differences that we will keep revolutionising the way for our customers. We are better together!

What We Do…

We’re people who love technology but know that hoteliers just want things to be simple. So since 2006 we’ve been constantly innovating our world-leading hotel commerce platform to help accommodation owners find and book more guests online - quickly and simply.

We’ve helped everyone from boutique hotels to big chains, enabling travellers to book igloos, cabins, castles, holiday parks, campsites, pubs, resorts, Airbnbs, and everything in between.

And today, we’re the world’s leading open hotel commerce platform, supporting 50,000 hotels in 150+ countries - with over 130 million reservations processed by SiteMinder’s technology every year.

The Onboarding Specialist role

We provide you with product and internal software training and pair you with a seasoned buddy to perform mock training before we have you training our customers.

description:
About the job

Performance Manager (Programmatic)

Job Details

Role: Performance Manager (Programmatic)

Department: Performance (Programmatic)

Job Location: Remote (Mexico)

Role Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Hours: Monday - Friday 9AM-5PM (in your timezone, flexible hours)

Total Compensation: $607,000 - $789,000 MXN + Benefits

New Hire Starting Pay: $607,000 - $744,000 MXN + Benefits

Role Availability: This posting is for an existing vacancy at Thrive Digital

As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply!

About Thrive



Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of - together.

The Opportunity

This is a build-and-grow moment. We're expanding our programmatic practice, and the work comes with a portfolio most marketers only get to admire from the outside. You'll partner with leading B2B and ecommerce brands to build media strategies that go beyond the traditional Google and Meta mix, using channels like Connected TV, programmatic display, online video, native, and emerging opportunities to drive measurable business growth. You won't just be running campaigns; you'll be the strategic partner helping clients answer bigger questions around audience strategy, incrementality, measurement, and long-term growth. The tactical craft matters, but here it's in service of something bigger: shaping full-funnel media strategies that influence pipeline, customer acquisition, and lifetime value. If you're excited by solving complex business challenges, thinking beyond platform best practices, and helping shape the future of programmatic media, let's chat.

The Role

Joining the Performance department (performance marketing) as our Performance Manager (Programmatic), you'll be responsible for driving project excellence in Performance Programs by implementing growth strategies, solving complex problems, and fostering team development to ensure that Thrive remains an industry leader in performance marketing. You'll oversee the success of some of our highest priority brands and partnerships, ranging from household names through to brands that are in early growth stages. You'll also be a key contributor to product innovation and project growth initiatives, working amongst a collaborative team to continuously improve our product and service.

Your focus will of responsibilities will be:


Domain: Recognized as a leader in performance marketing at Thrive, you solve client challenges with innovative solutions, advocate for team member career growth, and contribute to agency-wide thought leadership in your area of expertise.
Example: You'll lead teams in the research, media planning and strategic roadmaps across some of our largest brands. You are responsible for mobilizing internal teams and working alongside them from inception through to hands-on, ongoing execution execution and optimization, while reporting to stakeholders on key performance indicators.


Client: Improve and redefine client success standards at Thrive by championing exceptional client service. Solve client and project issues with performance marketing solutions and provide advice on workflow and resource management.
Example: You lead strategic conversations with some of our largest clients 1:1, proactively engaging in and consistently monitoring client sentiment to ensure we’re addressing any challenges and opportunities. You provide constructive feedback to team members and work in partnership with the senior operational team to address any resourcing, performance or economic shifts.


People: Enhance the Performance department’s expertise by mentoring and managing team members, and contributing to their development through upskilling, training content, workshops, and other company resources.
Example: You either manage team members directly or work closely with them in a mentor and advocate capacity. Operating at a senior-manager level, you develop other leaders & address any role performance challenges proactively and appropriately. You set team members up for success to continuously elevate their roles on projects, are expert at giving feedback and approach difficult conversations with confidence and care.


Company: Make significant contributions to people and projects within the Performance department by solving complex problems, coordinating support, and aligning with stakeholders. Use performance marketing expertise to enhance organizational initiatives and support company goals.
Example: You lead company-level conversations and initiatives that keep us on the leading edge of performance marketing. You get buy-in, work through change management, and successfully collaborate with cross-functional support as needed.

We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:


In your first 30 days you’ll familiarize yourself with Thrive’s tools and processes and begin onboarding to projects and teams across your department, identifying performance opportunities and building relationships.
In your first 60 days you’ll be playing an active role across projects, collaborating with teams on day-to-day and longer-term account initiatives. You’ll begin developing processes and strategies to improve team and project success and sharing key insights with others.
In your first 90 days you’ll be stepping into account leadership opportunities, providing support across project planning, strategy, client partnerships and team skills development. You’ll begin collaborating with senior stakeholders across the company, leveraging your experience to provide valuable feedback and move initiatives forward. 


Qualifications


You've planned and executed multi-channel, full-funnel performance marketing campaigns with media spends exceeding $500k USD per month, delivering consistently positive ROI across programmatic platforms.
You’ve mobilized and led teams of 5-10, providing direct management, training, and strategic guidance to develop junior team members into management roles.
You’ve built and customized dashboards using tools like Google Sheets, Excel, Looker or Tableau to streamline reporting, analyze performance data, and focus on key business objectives and KPIs.
You’ve developed or improved internal initiatives or processes that have been adopted company-wide, elevating performance standards across the organization.
You’ve driven performance media strategy across diverse business verticals, having successfully led pacing, forecasting, and reporting with business objectives, and effectively communicated these strategies to senior stakeholders, including C-Suite executives.
You’ve successfully managed client relationships with multiple stakeholders, delivering strategic recommendations, resolving complex situations, and gaining buy-in through clear and effective communication across meetings and digital channels.


Equal Opportunity Employer

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works.

description:
About the job

About Blackbird e-Solutions LLC




Blackbird e-Solutions LLC is a boutique digital marketing agency built exclusively for the soccer industry. From youth clubs to apparel brands to training platforms, we help soccer businesses grow through SEO, AI search optimization, paid advertising, content marketing, and analytics. Our edge is that we live in the sport, not just market for it.




We are building something bigger. Behind the agency is a vertically integrated soccer holding company with ambitions that extend well past 2026. Club partnerships, apparel launches, and sports platforms are all on the roadmap.




About the Role




This is the hire that frees the founder to build. Our active retainer clients need consistent, reliable, autonomous day to day delivery, and we need someone who can own that completely. You will run our client portfolio without close oversight, owning predictable day-to-day fulfillment and task execution. You will master our client delivery loops behind the scenes first, allowing the founder to transition out of daily operations while maintaining rock-solid retention.




The soccer passion is not a nice to have. It is the filter. Because once this house is in order, your career path climbs directly into the soccer holding company side: coordinating club relationships, supporting apparel launches, and driving operations for our core sports platforms as we build toward and beyond the 2026 World Cup window.




What You Will Own




Client Delivery: Manage the day-to-day operations of our active retainer accounts, ensuring all deliverables are completed on time and to standard without founder involvement
Content Coordination: Own content calendars and publishing schedules across client accounts
Performance Oversight: Track and report on core digital marketing metrics across SEO and PPC, flagging issues and keeping clients informed
Task Management: Coordinate workflows, prioritize competing demands, and keep projects moving across the portfolio
Account Transition & Support: Initially, you will own the fulfillment engine behind the scenes while supporting the founder on client accounts. Over your first 60–90 days, you will be systematically introduced to clients, gradually transitioning into their trusted, primary point of contact




What We Are Looking For




2 to 4+ years in digital marketing operations, account management, or a similar client-facing operations role
Comfortable managing content schedules and overseeing SEO and PPC metrics without close supervision
Highly organized and self-directed, you operate without someone looking over your shoulder
Clear communicator who keeps clients confident and projects on track
Experience in an agency environment preferred




The Soccer Requirement




You must have a genuine, deep passion for soccer. Not casual interest, real passion. This is a soccer company at its core, and that shapes how we think, what we talk about, and where this goes.




Growth Path




This role starts in agency operations, but it does not stay there. As the business scales, high performers move into the soccer holding company side: coordinating club partnerships, supporting apparel and merchandise launches, and driving operations for our sports platforms. If soccer is your world, this is your way in.




Important notes for all applicants: We are unable to sponsor any visas or facilitate visa transfers. Applications and CVs must be in English to be considered. You must complete all applicant questions to be shortlisted for screening.




Blackbird e-Solutions asks respectfully to only apply through the application form and not email/apply to them directly. Recruiters and Agencies please do not contact Blackbird e-Solutions directly.




We read every application. Fully AI-generated answers to the applicant questions are easy to spot and will not be shortlisted — we want to hear from you, in your own words.

About the job

LinkedIn is the world's largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.



Join us to transform the way the world works.





Job Description



This role is part of LinkedIn’s broader effort to build and scale an in-house owned media agency, including the creation of tools that will significantly increase production speed and operational efficiency. As such, the position is structured as a 12-month contractor role. This role will be based in Mexico. 



At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is remote, meaning it will be performed from the designated home work location upon time of hire, and any changes to this home work location requires a review of remote status and approval. 



The Owned In-House Agency Team supports the LinkedIn Owned Media team, which leads channel strategy, prioritization, and performance across Email and LinkedIn Ads. This team partners closely with Owned Media to bring campaigns to life at scale, ensuring high-quality execution and operational excellence across a complex portfolio. This includes driving execution of campaign builds, QA, and reporting insights based on the Owned Media team's strategy and priorities. This team also plays a key role in enabling efficiency and consistency through the use and enablement of technology, automation, and tooling -- delivering impact through execution, scalability, and continuous improvement within a high-performing marketing organization. 



We are seeking an Email Activation Specialist to join our team at Mexico. This role is responsible for producing and launching a high volume of email workflows with varying complexities using Adobe Campaign, our email service provider. In this position, you will be building, QA'ing, and launching email campaigns. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in deploying high volume emails using different email marketing tools, specializing in HTML/CSS, SQL, and dynamic content scripts. They are responsible for email creation, workflow configuration, campaign segmentation, and QA. 



If you have a passion for email marketing and are looking to make an impact in a dynamic environment, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity. 



Responsibilities 



End-to-end execution of email campaigns including; building emails and workflows, creating audience segments, setting up tests, and scheduling email campaigns 



Create and manage workflows to support campaign objectives 



Set up and execute A/B test email campaigns 



Perform QA via a QA checklist for email campaigns 



Ensuring accurate rendering across different browsers, devices, and email clients 



Launch and ensure ongoing deployment success of daily, weekly, or ad-hoc campaigns in Adobe Campaign 



Troubleshoot rendering issues or performance issues of email campaigns 



Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and communicate execution requirements, timing, and SLAs.

3+ years of applicable experience 
2+ years of experience deploying high volume emails in an email marketing platform 
Business fluency in English, with ability to adapt messaging for varied audiences 



Preferred Qualifications:



BA/BS Degree
Proficient in responsive email design and front-end development.

Proven ability to manage multiple projects in a deadline-driven environment. 
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with ability to adapt messaging for varied audiences

Fundada sobre la base de la salud intestinal y experta en el microbioma, Plexus Worldwide® —con sede en Scottsdale, Arizona— es una reconocida empresa de venta directa y un empleador destacado. description:
About the job

Overview

We're looking for a customer-centric Shopify Ecommerce Experience Coordinator to join our client's team. Headquartered in Los Angeles, California, Right Balance provides top-tier technology talent for innovative companies. We're in the top 50 companies to watch in LA.




Engagement Details

Our client is a fast-growing, natural personal-care brand with a high-traffic Shopify storefront and a rapidly expanding retail presence. You'll own and optimize the day-to-day ecommerce experience across their storefront. This role goes beyond content management: it combines merchandising, ecommerce operations, experimentation, and analytics to continuously improve the customer journey and drive conversion.




The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable making data-driven decisions based on user behavior, A/B testing, and ecommerce performance insights.




What You’ll Do:

Own and manage all content launches across the Shopify storefront.
Manage and maintain Shopify Admin, including products, collections, tags, and inventory.
Coordinate product launches and merchandising initiatives.
Create and update landing pages.
Support SEO optimization efforts.
Plan, execute, and monitor A/B testing initiatives.
Analyze customer behavior and ecommerce funnel performance to identify optimization opportunities.
Make strategic recommendations based on data and user insights.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to continuously improve the online shopping experience.




Availability: Part-time hours. Long-term engagement with the potential to scale to full-time




What’s in it for you?

Learn and evolve your skills using the latest and greatest technology tools in a rapidly growing company.
Learn from the best people around you. We constantly challenge the status quo and invent new ways of building a great product.
100% remote. Work anywhere, whether it is remotely in the comfort of your home, in a shared co-working space, in an RV on the beach, or while being a nomad in another country.
Work on challenging problems, innovate, and positively impact many people's lives while having fun doing it.




Required Qualifications

Advanced to fluent speaking and writing English. Able to have a real-time conversation.
3+ years managing Shopify storefronts.
3+ years in ecommerce operations and merchandising.
2+ years coordinating content and product launches.
2+ years with A/B testing and conversion optimization.
Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret customer behavior and ecommerce metrics.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Customer-centric approach to decision-making.
Ability to prioritize multiple initiatives in a fast-paced environment.




Nice to Haves

Experience with SEO best practices.
Experience optimizing ecommerce funnels and customer journeys.
Familiarity with product merchandising strategies.
Experience working with Shopify apps and ecommerce optimization tools.
Experience supporting high-growth ecommerce brands.




Frequently Asked Questions

What are your typical clients?

The majority of our clients are venture-backed startups at the growth stage. Usually, at this stage, the company already achieved a product-market fit and is looking to expand rapidly. That’s where we bring the best engineering practices, strong architecture, the latest technologies, and consistent processes to help companies scale.




What is the length of your engagements?

Most of our long-term full-time engagements last multiple years. It allows you to evolve your career with the client company taking on more responsibilities.




What’s your company size?

The Right Balance team is 55+ engineers going to 75+ by the end of the year. The timing is great to be a part of a rapidly growing team making meaningful contributions.




What happens if the engagement is completed?

Most of our engagements are long-term in nature. That said, if the current engagement is ramping down, we’ll present you with more long-term opportunities to transition into.




What are your core values?

Client First: we only win when our clients win. We treat client challenges as our own.
Ownership: we embrace responsibility, taking on challenges, getting them to completion, and enjoying getting things done.
Quality: we’re passionate about achieving quality outcomes by applying meticulous attention to detail.

About Lendable
Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:


One of the UK’s newest unicorns with a team of just over 700 people
Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK
Profitable since 2017
Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs
Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)


So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

Take ownership across a broad remit. You are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1
Work in small teams of exceptional people, who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo
Build the best technology in-house, using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting


About the Role: 

We’ve rebuilt core consumer finance products from scratch, loans, credit cards, and car finance, delivering money to customers in minutes instead of days. We are now launching our credit card product in Mexico and building our founding local team.

Customer support is critical to our success. Many of our customers are entering the formal financial system for the first time, and the way we support them matters deeply.

We’re looking for a Customer Support Agent to help deliver an excellent, friendly, and trustworthy experience to our credit card customers in Mexico.

This is a junior, hands-on role focused on answering customer questions, resolving issues, and guiding customers through our product and processes. You’ll be on the front lines of customer interaction, helping people understand their credit card, payments, balances, and next steps.

You don’t need to build tools or write code, but you do need to be empathetic, detail-oriented, reliable, and eager to learn. Many of the questions you handle will not yet be automated, and your work will directly help us improve our product and processes over time.

What You’ll Do

Always prioritise customer trust, clarity, and compliance.
 Learn the Product Deeply

Stay up to date with changes to features, processes, and FAQs.
Use internal documentation and tools to provide consistent answers.
 Improve Support Quality Over Time

Required

Why Join Ford of Mexico?

 Remain knowledgeable and prepared for upcoming changes to processes and technology.

 Bachelor’s degree is preferred. Minimum scholarity: High School.

 Customer service mindset.
